form.title: Somatic Variant Calling
form.description: MuTect1, DeepSomatic and Manta/Strelka on preprocessed BAM/CRAM, with an optional consensus across the selected callers.

use_mutect.title: MuTect1
use_mutect.description: Run MuTect1 (SNVs only). Needs BAM input, not CRAM.

use_deepsomatic.title: DeepSomatic
use_deepsomatic.description: Run DeepSomatic (SNVs and indels). Needs a GPU.

use_strelka.title: Strelka (with Manta)
use_strelka.description: Run Manta, then Strelka2 seeded with Manta's candidate indels (SNVs and indels). Manta's SV calls are published too.

run_consensus.title: Generate consensus
run_consensus.description: When two or more callers are selected, also write a consensus VCF per sample on top of each caller's own results. SNVs: a variant must be called by at least n-1 callers (both, if two). Indels: same rule over the callers that report indels (MuTect1 does not).

ref.title: Reference genome
ref.description: Reference genome build. The selected build must match the FASTA, dictionary, indexes, annotation VCFs, and BAM alignment build.

ref_fasta.title: Reference FASTA
ref_fasta.description: Reference genome FASTA used by MuTect1.

ref_fai.title: Reference FASTA index
ref_fai.description: FAI index corresponding to the reference FASTA.

ref_dict.title: Reference sequence dictionary
ref_dict.description: Sequence dictionary corresponding to the reference FASTA.

wes.title: Targeted/exome data
wes.description: Adds --exome to Manta and Strelka. Leave off for whole-genome data.

num_streams_per_gpu.title: Streams per GPU
num_streams_per_gpu.description: Number of streams to process per GPU (1-6). Higher values improve throughput but use more host memory (3 was OOM-killed at 60 GB on WGS). Default: 1

enable_gvcf.title: Output gVCF
enable_gvcf.description: Generate gVCF output in addition to VCF

scatter_count.title: Scatter count
scatter_count.description: Number of parallel MuTect1 shards. Higher values may reduce wall-clock time but increase scheduling and compute overhead.

padding_bp.title: Interval padding (bp)
padding_bp.description: Number of base pairs to pad each interval shard on both sides. Padding prevents edge artifacts when scatter-gathering. NeoDisc default: 100bp.

target_list.title: Calling intervals (BED or interval list)
target_list.description: Optional regions restricting all callers (MuTect1, Manta, Strelka), e.g. the WGS calling regions without decoy/alt contigs. Leave blank for genome-wide calling.

contest_target_intervals.title: ContEst target intervals
contest_target_intervals.description: Optional target interval file used by ContEst. ContEst runs only when this, SNP6 BED, and HapMap VCF are all supplied.

fracContam.title: Fallback contamination fraction
fracContam.description: Contamination fraction passed to MuTect1 when the full ContEst input set is not supplied.

dbsnp.title: dbSNP VCF
dbsnp.description: Optional dbSNP VCF for MuTect1 annotation.

dbsnp_idx.title: dbSNP index
dbsnp_idx.description: Index corresponding to the dbSNP VCF.

read_group_blacklist.title: Read-group blacklist
read_group_blacklist.description: Optional file listing read groups that MuTect1 should ignore.

downsample.title: Downsample coverage
downsample.description: Maximum coverage used by MuTect1 downsampling.

max_mismatch_baseq_sum.title: Maximum mismatch base-quality sum
max_mismatch_baseq_sum.description: MuTect1 maximum mismatch base-quality sum threshold.

force_calling.title: Enable force calling
force_calling.description: Enable MuTect1 force-calling behavior configured by the pipeline.

exclude_chimeric.title: Exclude chimeric reads
exclude_chimeric.description: Exclude chimeric read pairs during MuTect1 calling.

force_calling_intervals.title: Force-calling interval list
force_calling_intervals.description: Optional pre-computed interval list from a previous MuTect1 run (force_calling.interval_list). When provided, takes precedence over target_list.
